svg.title: The four-quadrant autopsy sheet: correct, plausible-but-wrong, missing, hidden assumption
svg.desc: A two-by-two grid. Quadrant one: correct – checks out at the source. Quadrant two: plausible-but-wrong – sounds right, is not. Quadrant three: missing – what the text avoids. Quadrant four, highlighted in yellow: hidden assumption – assumed, never stated, the hardest field. Caption: one sheet per group, at least one entry per quadrant.
svg.text: assumed, never stated – the hardest field
One sheet per group · at least one entry per quadrant · settle disputes at the source, not by majority
